top_signals.title: Italian Defense Minister Calls for Stronger Naval Protection in the Red Sea
top_signals.summary: Italy's defence minister on Friday called for a stronger naval presence in the Red Sea to protect merchant shipping amid concerns over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a vital waterway threatened by the widening Middle East conflict.The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen have made rapid advances in recent weeks
